summaries.name: Dell XPS 13
summaries.summary: The user pre-ordered a Dell XPS 13 laptop on January 28th; it was originally expected to arrive on February 11th but was delayed, finally arriving on February 25th. The laptop uses a USB-C power adapter, compatible with US power standards (120V, 60Hz), and has a battery capacity of around 52Wh (approximately 13,000mAh).

summaries.name: Belkin Boost Up
summaries.summary: Belkin Boost Up is the user's wireless charging pad, normally used at home to charge their phone and smartwatch. The user decided to leave it at home for their Hawaii trip rather than bring it, opting to use a travel adapter with multiple USB ports and cables instead to save space and reduce bulk in their luggage.
